text: Enlightened Ayanad Accessories are custom accessories that was added in Patch 1.3.6. Enlightened Ayanad Accessories allows you to improve on your Ayanad Accessories by changing their stats, adding a skill to your necklace or changing their effects into the whole new Library Accessory lineup. Enlightening an Ayanad Accessory Step 1 - Ayanad Accessory To begin the process you first need to obtain an Ayanad Accessory that you want to Enlighten. Do not worry about the main stats it gives, just consider which "Equip effect" you want. When enlightening it you'll be able to apply any stat combination onto them that you desire. This is just my opinion but considering this process is quite resource intensive I recommend at bare minimum to only enlighten Divine+ Ayanad Accessories. Use the in-game Equipment Encyclopedia to see each Enlightened version, their equip effects are slightly improved. Step 2 - Enlightened Runestone To enlighten an accessory you'll need to use an Enlightened Runestone on the Ayanad Accessory you have prepared. Recipe Enlightened Runestone Proficiency Handicrafts 50,000 Labor Cost × 200 Workbench Disciple's Workbench Materials Dormant Runestone × 1 Starlight Archeum Essence × 5 Ayanad Starlight Blessing × 1 Blue Salt Hammer × 50 Use: Spend 10 labor to unlock the secrets of Ayanad. Disciple's Workbench locations. Once crafted you will need to go to the top floor in Library to use the Enlightened Runestone on your accessory. The easiest way to achieve this is to buy a Ayanad Scroll: 3rd Floor Lobby from the Auction House to instantly teleport to the top of Library, it can be used from anywhere in Diamond Shores. Step 2.1 - Obtaining the Dormant Runestone The Dormant Runestone can rarely be obtained from Scholar's Research Bundle, Librarian's Research Bundle and Dean's Research Bundle which are obtained by killing monsters in Library. Step 2.2 - Obtaining the Ayanad Starlight Blessing Recipe Ayanad Starlight Blessing Proficiency N/A Labor Cost × 500 Workbench Ipnysh Altar Materials Acid Vessel × 2 Complete Cursed Armor × 2 Earthmana Leaf × 100 Prismatic Diamond × 25 Ayanad Accessory Scroll × 1 Black Pearl × 5 Acid Vessel × 1 requires Acid Goblet × 200 and 1,500 Labor. Acid Goblet can rarely be obtained when slaying monsters in Aegis Island. Complete Cursed Armor × 1 requires Cursed Armor Scrap × 200 and 1,500 Labor. Cursed Armor Scrap can rarely be obtained when slaying monsters in Whalesong Harbor. Step 3 - Lunasigils, Applying Stats Once an accessory is enlightened it loses its main stats. You can apply new stats on it using a Lunasigil. Example: You prepared an Ayanad Wave Earring for enlightenment. Before Runestone Earring Divine Ayanad Wave Earring Intelligence 25 Equip effect Decreases received damage -2.4%. After Runestone Earring Divine Enlightened Ayanad Wave Earring Equip effect Decreases received damage -2.8%. These are the Lunasigils you can craft and put into your Enlightened Accessories: Hybrid Stat Perfect Desert Lunasigil Strength 20 Stamina 20 Perfect Lake Lunasigil Stamina 20 Intelligence 20 Perfect Lightning Lunasigil Strength 20 Agility 20 Perfect Meadow Lunasigil Intelligence 20 Spirit 20 Perfect Meteor Lunasigil Strength 20 Spirit 20 Perfect Mist Lunasigil Agility 20 Spirit 20 Perfect Squall Lunasigil Agility 20 Stamina 20 Perfect Stone Lunasigil Stamina 20 Spirit 20 Perfect Sunset Lunasigil Strength 20 Intelligence 20 Perfect Tidal Lunasigil Agility 20 Intelligence 20 Pure Stat Perfect Earth Lunasigil Stamina 35 Perfect Flame Lunasigil Strength 35 Perfect Gale Lunasigil Agility 35 Perfect Life Lunasigil Spirit 35 Perfect Wave Lunasigil Intelligence 35 WARNING: Lunasigils cannot be stacked with the accessory Lunafrosts from the Loyalty Shop. html:
Enlightened Ayanad Accessories are custom accessories that was added in Patch 1.3.6. Enlightened Ayanad Accessories allows you to improve on your Ayanad Accessories by changing their stats, adding a skill to your necklace or changing their effects into the whole new Library Accessory lineup.

Enlightening an Ayanad Accessory

Step 1 - Ayanad Accessory

To begin the process you first need to obtain an Ayanad Accessory that you want to Enlighten. Do not worry about the main stats it gives, just consider which "Equip effect" you want. When enlightening it you'll be able to apply any stat combination onto them that you desire.

This is just my opinion but considering this process is quite resource intensive I recommend at bare minimum to only enlighten Divine+ Ayanad Accessories.

Use the in-game Equipment Encyclopedia to see each Enlightened version, their equip effects are slightly improved.

Step 2 - Enlightened Runestone

To enlighten an accessory you'll need to use an Enlightened Runestone on the Ayanad Accessory you have prepared.

Recipe Enlightened Runestone
Proficiency Handicrafts 50,000
Labor Cost × 200
Workbench Disciple's Workbench
Materials Dormant Runestone × 1
Starlight Archeum Essence × 5
Ayanad Starlight Blessing × 1
Blue Salt Hammer × 50
Use:
Spend 10 labor to unlock the secrets of Ayanad.

Once crafted you will need to go to the top floor in Library to use the Enlightened Runestone on your accessory. The easiest way to achieve this is to buy a Ayanad Scroll: 3rd Floor Lobby from the Auction House to instantly teleport to the top of Library, it can be used from anywhere in Diamond Shores.

Step 2.1 - Obtaining the Dormant Runestone

The Dormant Runestone can rarely be obtained from Scholar's Research Bundle, Librarian's Research Bundle and Dean's Research Bundle which are obtained by killing monsters in Library.

Step 2.2 - Obtaining the Ayanad Starlight Blessing

Recipe Ayanad Starlight Blessing
Proficiency N/A
Labor Cost × 500
Workbench Ipnysh Altar
Materials Acid Vessel × 2
Complete Cursed Armor × 2
Earthmana Leaf × 100
Prismatic Diamond × 25
Ayanad Accessory Scroll × 1
Black Pearl × 5

Acid Vessel × 1 requires Acid Goblet × 200 and 1,500 Labor.

  • Acid Goblet can rarely be obtained when slaying monsters in Aegis Island.

Complete Cursed Armor × 1 requires Cursed Armor Scrap × 200 and 1,500 Labor.

  • Cursed Armor Scrap can rarely be obtained when slaying monsters in Whalesong Harbor.

Step 3 - Lunasigils, Applying Stats

Once an accessory is enlightened it loses its main stats. You can apply new stats on it using a Lunasigil.

Example: You prepared an Ayanad Wave Earring for enlightenment.
